title: PM expresses sorrow at death of Roger Kirk
content:
7 April 2011

PM expresses sorrow at death of Roger Kirk

  • John Key
Prime Minister

Prime Minister John Key today expressed his sadness at news of the death of Roger Kirk, husband of former National Party President Judy Kirk.



“I knew Roger well, and I am shocked and saddened at his tragic and sudden death,” says Mr Key.



“I have known Roger as long as I have known Judy, and counted him as a friend.



“Along with Judy, he was a good friend of the National Party. I would like to express my deepest condolences to Roger’s family, friends and colleagues at this time.”
